flagship_project.name: Project BharatMesh: Multilingual Voice/Visual Social Commerce Engine, 0-Commission P2P Reseller Supply Mesh & Tier-4 Logistics Arbiter
flagship_project.pillar: Vernacular Multimodal Discovery & Ultra-Low-Cost P2P Supply Chain Routing
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Meesho thrives on low Average Order Values (AOVs) and unbranded goods from Tier-2/3/4 towns. BharatMesh replaces complex text search with natural voice and camera visual search in 14 Indian languages, while dynamically bundling hyper-local couriers to drive per-shipment delivery cost down by 30%.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Python / PyTorch (Speech-to-Intent & Image Embeddings), Milvus / Qdrant (Vector Similarity Database), Go (Order Matching Engine), ScyllaDB, Kafka, Kubernetes on Bare Metal
flagship_project.kpis: Supports 50M concurrent vernacular voice queries; reduces RTO (Return to Origin) fraud by 38%; drives shipping costs down to <₹35 per intra-zone parcel.
